findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Procurement.Rules.approvalLimits matches no observation and cites no authority: decimal literal 7500.00 (line 7); decimal literal 40000.00 (line 8). Value 7500.00 equals DEC-PR01.p1 (superseded by DEC-PR04). Value 40000.00 equals DEC-PR01.p2 (superseded by DEC-PR04). Value 40000.00 equals DEC-PR04.p2 (accepted). The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Finance Controller: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
